third_party_evaluations.summary: OCI security controls: IAM, network security, data protection, threat detection, compliance.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded breadth across IAM, network protection, data and detection supports professional control decisions despite a two-year profile; vendor specificity limits cross-cloud portability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: OCI IAM, network, data-protection and detection controls support associate platform-security knowledge with a two-year profile. The professional hint is noted, but the record supplies no senior-scope or practical evidence establishing independent professional delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded OCI IAM, network controls and data-protection scope is useful operational knowledge. A two-year profile and no explicit practical component support associate placement below the Professional product label.
